rules.description: Regular paracetamol use may enhance warfarin's anticoagulant effect.
NSAIDs combined with warfarin significantly increase bleeding risk.
NSAIDs may reduce the antihypertensive effect of losartan and stress the kidneys.
Decongestants can raise blood pressure, counteracting antihypertensive treatment.
Combining two antihistamines increases sedation without added benefit.
Reduced but not eliminated GI risk; monitor for stomach discomfort.
